title: Tech Note: Notarizing a Built 4D Application in v17 and v18
author: Erick Lui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note documents notarizing via the legacy 'xcrun altool' workflow that Apple has since deprecated and shut down in favor of 'xcrun notarytool'; the v17-specific manual entitlements/inside-out signing steps are still conceptually informative but the exact commands no longer work on current macOS/Xcode toolchains.
related_updates: Apple retired the altool notarization API; 'notarytool' is now mandatory, with different command syntax and keychain-profile-based credentials
4D's 'Sign application' build feature (highlighted here as hassle-free starting in v18) remains the current recommended way to sign 4D apps prior to notarization
